---
title: "Make Data"
---

This page generates the experimental data: simulated survey respondents are assigned personas (from `persona_dass21_final.json`) and answer the DASS-21 questionnaire (`dass21questions.json`) via `SurveyResponder.py`.

```{python}
from SurveyResponder import SurveyResponder

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

from IPython.display import display, Markdown

# While building and testing we'll use just 2 responses
num_responses = 2

responder = SurveyResponder(
    questions_path="dass21questions.json",
    persona_path="persona_dass21_final.json",
    model_name="olmo2:7b",
    num_responses=num_responses,
    temperature=2.0,
    base_url="http://localhost:11434/api/generate"
)

df = responder.run_write(
    "data_running_tests/initial-1006/results.csv",
    validate=True,          # check response in ["valid_responses"]
    on_invalid="recode",    # "none" | "retry" | "recode"
    max_retries=2)          # only used when on_invalid="retry"

display(Markdown(df.head().to_markdown()))
```
